title: PendingPrompt
description: A prompt an agent waits on, for auto-continue (CONTRACT.md: PendingPrompt).

payload.description: PromptPayload from gitrochi-autocontinue. Structured questions retain multiSelect, options with explicit recommended flags, and optional suggestedAnswer drafts. autoAnswer=false is a live manual question: its positive deadline releases without an automatic reply. payload.hold marks a terminal-only wait.

deadline.description: Epoch milliseconds; 0 for a terminal-only held wait (payload.hold says why). A positive deadline with payload.autoAnswer=false is a live manual wait's expiry, never an automatic answer countdown.
